title: Query count of the seeded interleaved tree
statement: Let $s$ be a seed consisting of four indices in $\{0,1,2\}$, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^{9}$. The query count of the interleaved decision tree determined by $s$ on input $x$ equals its prescribed interleaved model cost on $s$ and $x$.
hypotheses_covered: seed is a tuple of four indices in a three-element set
input is a sign-valued function on nine coordinates
